_note: Which project/product each account belongs to. Empty is fine to start: the GP-by-project topic simply stays empty until a company is listed here. Keys under 'companies' are the 'short' names from build-data.mjs.

_readme: Copy this block, rename it to a company short name, and fill it in.
revenue: account code -> project name. An account not listed keeps its own name as the project.
cost:    account code -> project name, or an object of weights that split it across projects.
Any cost account NOT listed is treated as shared and allocated by revenue share.
Allocation carries no information - it forces every project to the company margin.
The dashboard shows what share of costs is directly attributed. Push that number up.
